snippet.title: OLAPU // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331590/OLAPU/

OLAPU is an action roguelite in which you survive an onslaught of cute creatures on the path to defeating the most powerful beings in the realm. To stand any chance of surviving you must gather stars and complete your constellations. Recover the realm alone or in up to 4 player online co-op!

Developed by
bati and dxriiia
